project.name: Pre-Visit Financial Clearance System
project.problem_statement: Build an intelligent healthcare pre-visit financial clearance platform that automates patient insurance eligibility verification, reduces data-entry errors, confirms coverage before appointments, prevents eligibility-related claim denials, reduces administrative workload, and identifies systemic denial root causes so upstream workflows can be improved.
project.primary_goal: Determine whether a patient is financially and administratively ready for a specific healthcare service before the patient visit, identify what could go wrong, recommend corrective actions, and prevent recurring problems at the workflow level.
project.core_value_proposition: Do not wait for an eligibility problem to become a claim denial. Detect, resolve, and prevent the problem before the patient visit.
project.data_policy: Use only synthetic/mock patient, insurance, appointment, coverage, and claim data for the hackathon. Do not use real patient data.

data_entry_errors.problem: Manual entry of member IDs, policy numbers, names, DOBs, and other insurance information can introduce errors.

delayed_coverage_confirmation.problem: Coverage issues may be discovered too late, sometimes close to or during the patient's appointment.

eligibility_related_claim_denials.problem: Claims can be denied because of inactive insurance, incorrect information, missing authorization, coverage restrictions, or network issues.

administrative_burden.problem: Staff must manually review many patients and decide which cases require immediate attention.

recurring_systemic_denials.problem: Fixing hundreds of individually denied claims does not address the underlying workflow problem.
solution_features: Root Cause Analysis & Denial Pattern Detection

features.name: Automated Insurance Eligibility Verification
features.description: Automatically verify whether a patient's insurance policy is active and eligible for the upcoming encounter.

features.name: Insurance Card OCR & Data Extraction
features.description: Extract insurance and patient information from an uploaded insurance card.

features.name: Intelligent Data Validation
features.description: Compare OCR-extracted insurance information with the hospital patient record and identify field-level inconsistencies before verification.

features.name: Real-Time Coverage Verification
features.description: Determine whether the specific planned procedure or service is covered by the patient's insurance plan.
solves: incorrect assumption that active insurance means every service is covered

features.name: Prior Authorization Detection
features.description: Determine whether the planned procedure requires prior authorization and whether authorization is already present.

features.name: Referral & Network Verification
features.description: Check referral requirements and whether the provider/hospital is in-network for the patient's plan.

features.name: Patient Financial Responsibility Estimator
features.description: Estimate patient out-of-pocket responsibility using procedure cost, coverage, deductible, copay, and coinsurance information.

features.name: Eligibility & Claim Risk Score
features.description: Calculate a 0-100 risk score representing the likelihood of an eligibility-related problem or claim denial.
features.implementation: Start with an explainable deterministic weighted-rule engine. ML can be added later if time and synthetic historical data permit.

features.name: Explainable Risk Analysis
features.description: Show exactly why a patient received a particular risk score and how individual factors contribute to it.

features.name: Automated Clearance Status
features.description: Combine eligibility, validation, coverage, authorization, network, referral, financial, and risk results into a single operational status.
features.decision_rule: A patient should not be marked CLEARED when a critical unresolved eligibility, coverage, or authorization issue exists.

features.name: Recommended Action Engine
features.description: Translate detected problems into concrete next actions for staff.

examples.action: Verify insurance card and update the hospital patient record.
Start authorization workflow before the appointment.
Contact payer or obtain updated insurance information.

features.name: Pre-Visit Priority Dashboard & Alerts
features.description: Centralize upcoming patients, clearance statuses, risk, urgency, and unresolved issues, and alert staff about high-priority cases.
features.priority_logic: Rank patients using risk score, appointment proximity, and financial impact.

features.name: Root Cause Analysis & Denial Pattern Detection
features.description: Analyze historical claims and denial data, group denials by common causes, identify recurring patterns, and surface systemic workflow problems.

example.finding: A large number of authorization denials indicates an upstream authorization workflow problem rather than 300 unrelated claim problems.

features.name: Preventive Workflow Automation
features.description: Use recurring denial patterns and coverage rules to trigger preventive actions upstream during appointment creation or pre-visit clearance.

steps: If yes, check whether authorization is present
If authorization is missing, automatically create authorization task and alert staff

features.goal: Prevent future claims from failing for the same known reason.

features.name: Continuous Process Improvement Dashboard
features.description: Measure whether preventive workflow interventions reduce recurring denial causes over time.

core_workflow: Add Patient to Priority Queue if Action Required

systemic_prevention_workflow.purpose: Move from reactive denial correction to proactive prevention.

example_scenarios.name: Cleared Patient
example_scenarios.scenario: Insurance active, procedure covered, authorization not required, data matches, in-network.

example_scenarios.name: Authorization Required
example_scenarios.scenario: Insurance active and procedure covered, but prior authorization is required and missing.

example_scenarios.name: Data Mismatch
example_scenarios.scenario: Insurance card member ID differs from hospital record member ID.
example_scenarios.recommended_action: Verify insurance card and correct patient/insurance record.

example_scenarios.name: Expired Insurance
example_scenarios.scenario: Policy is expired for the appointment date.
example_scenarios.recommended_action: Verify updated insurance or alternative coverage.

example_scenarios.name: Systemic Authorization Problem
example_scenarios.scenario: 300 historical claims were denied because authorization was missing.
example_scenarios.root_cause: Authorization workflow is not being triggered when certain appointments are created.
example_scenarios.preventive_action: Automatically check authorization requirements and start an authorization task when a qualifying appointment is created.

recommended_tech_stack.ai: LLM API for explanation, summarization, and natural-language querying; deterministic rules remain authoritative for eligibility and coverage decisions.

architecture.external_integration: Mock payer APIs for hackathon demonstration
architecture.principle: Keep eligibility, coverage, risk, financial calculation, OCR, and workflow automation modular.

clearance_logic.CLEARED: No unresolved critical eligibility, coverage, authorization, validation, or network issue.
clearance_logic.NEEDS_ACTION: Patient is potentially eligible but one or more resolvable issues require staff action.
clearance_logic.HIGH_RISK: A critical issue such as inactive/expired insurance, major data mismatch, non-covered service, or severe unresolved eligibility problem exists.

risk_scoring_guideline.note: Weights are illustrative for the hackathon and should be configurable.

demo_story.primary_message: We do not wait for eligibility problems to become claim denials; we identify and resolve them before the patient visit and learn from recurring denial patterns to prevent them in the future.
patient_demo: Compare OCR data with hospital record
Show a detected mismatch or successful match
systemic_demo: Group them into a common root cause
Identify missing authorization workflow as the upstream problem
Automatically create authorization task and alert
Show how the future denial is prevented

non_goals: Do not use real patient data.
Do not make real medical diagnoses.
Do not make real insurance adjudication decisions.
Do not claim to provide guaranteed reimbursement amounts.
Do not integrate with real payer systems for the hackathon unless explicitly available and authorized.
Do not let an LLM override deterministic eligibility, coverage, or authorization rules.
Do not overbuild unrelated hospital-management functionality.
